text:
Alex Chen: Quick RFC follow-up — RFC-2024-07 (kernel selection & attention opt). I sketched a rollout playbook for runtime toggles: per-model flags, ordered fallback chains, canary percentages, telemetry hooks, and a kill-switch. Need quick alignment before I file the runtime-config PR.

Maria Gomez: Sounds good. Please call out failure metrics we should watch (model-mismatch, logits anomalies, latency spikes).

Jon Patel: One clarification — should flags be scoped to model_id or model_version? My vote is model_version so we don't accidentally flip behavior on a model upgrade/rollback.

Alex Chen: Agreed @Jon. We'll scope to model_version. Also plan to support a "global-mode" default for customers without per-model config.

Tara Singh: Important: caching interactions. If we change kernel mid-session we must invalidate prefix/KV cache or ensure compatibility layer. Add that to the playbook.

Alex Chen: Good call. Add a compatibility matrix. Minimal example config: 

```yaml
feature_flags:
  per_model:
    - model: 'gopher-13b'
      version: 'v2'
      flags:
        kernel: 'attn_opt_v2'
        fallback_chain: ['attn_opt_v2', 'attn_compat_v1', 'cpu_generic']
        canary_pct: 5
        invalidate_cache_on_fallback: true
```

Jon Patel: How do we pick fallback ordering? Prefer newer optimized kernel -> compatibility kernel -> CPU generic? Also: should we prefer quantized variant before CPU?

Maria Gomez: Fallback order should be: same-family optimized -> quantized variant (if quality OK) -> compatibility kernel -> CPU. Telemetry must tag quality regressions per fallback bucket.

Alex Chen: Example admin command for toggles: 

```bash
rictl flag set --model gopher-13b --version v2 --kernel attn_opt_v2 --fallback attn_compat_v1,cpu_generic --canary 5 --region us-east-1
```

Tara Singh: Add rollout guardrails: 
- canary ramp schedule (5 -> 25 -> 50 -> 100)
- auto-rollback on >2x error rate or >20% latency P95 regression
- global kill-switch that forces all models to compatibility kernel

Maria Gomez: Also: add per-customer opt-out and an audit log for flag changes (who / when / reason).

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Toggle applied: gopher-13b:v2 -> attn_opt_v2 (canary 5%) in us-east-1.

Alex Chen: Action items: 1) eng-runtime (Jon/Tara) add config API + cache invalidation hooks; 2) telemetry (Maria) add fallback buckets + regression alerts; 3) docs/runbook (Alex) with ramp schedule and kill-switch. I'll open the RFC-2024-07 follow-up PR linking this thread.

Jon Patel: I'll start the API sketch.

Tara Singh: I'll prototype cache-invalidator and a small compatibility test matrix.

Maria Gomez: I'll add the metrics list and alert thresholds to the telemetry ticket.

Alex Chen: Thanks all. If no objections by EOD Friday I'll merge the playbook into the runtime-config repo and start the canary. :rocket:

Maria Gomez: :thumbsup:

Jon Patel: :+1:

Tara Singh: 👍
